title: For me it’s the best
body: I tried many similar apps but only with this one I fell in love. The user interface, the widgets, the functionality - everything is awesome. And the best thing is that it’s not overloaded with unnecessary features
author: Perioad

title: The cleanest, most helpful habit app I've used so far
body: No-nonsense approach to user experience. Does what it says, without bloat. Plz keep it that way :)
author: Morengas
